limitsOfEvidence: The 320 MiB boundary is checked without allocating an oversized fixture. The largest full browser persistence fixture was 128 MiB, with minimal GPU geometry.
Real-asset validation used the supplied 49.75 MB banana tree, with 1,401,134 triangles and three embedded images; its binary geometry/texture chunks retained their SHA-256 hash after import.
Preview time is one observed import, not a repeatable performance benchmark. Dense instancing, other devices and the complete browser suite were not tested for this change.
Original art and generated project/screenshot files remain local and are not checked into the source repository.
Authoring still uses embedded strings. Linked binary storage and multi-gigabyte assets remain future work.
